summary: Asking about the same video twice no longer makes Nora watch it again: a clip's reading is kept and reused, for videos in the room and for Reels and Stories read by link.
details: A repeat look at the same clip answers straight away instead of spending a minute or more re-reading it.
A reading is reused only while nothing it depends on has changed; a new describer or route, a new question to the describer, a different video encode or a longer reading limit makes Nora look again.
A reading that came back incomplete or degraded for any reason that might not repeat is not kept, so the next ask tries again.
limitations: A question about a specific detail of a clip is still answered by a fresh look each time.
A kept reading, including any speech transcribed from it, stays until it is deleted; the video itself is never kept.
